title: Check: The Physical Layer and Media

questions.prompt: The physical layer is which OSI layer? (a number)
What does the physical layer actually do?
options: Makes sure data arrives in order
Turns bits into signals (voltages, light, or radio waves) on the medium, and back into bits at the other end

questions.prompt: The physical layer reads the destination address in a frame to decide where to send it.
What's the general name for whatever a signal travels through between sender and receiver, like a cable or the air? (two words)
Which of these are all guided media?
options: Twisted pair, coaxial cable, fiber optic

questions.prompt: Which of these is an unguided medium?
Guided media are also called ______ media. (one word)
Fiber-optic cable carries the signal as light, not electricity.
